notes: Eclipse Loop 1.0.9 A big usability + reliability pass. Every menu button now behaves the same way, the pads look alive, and a pile of input and packaging bugs are gone. Menus & buttons - One rule for every menu button: left-click opens its menu of options; right-click opens it too. Pick a value and it applies. - Toggles stay toggles: PORTAL, REC MIDI and REC flip on left-click (PORTAL can be turned off again), with their options on right-click. - SPLIT STEMS is a chooser — it always shows the 4-vs-6 + destination menu instead of blind-splitting. - QUANT has a proper grid menu: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 plus triplet (T) and dotted (.) divisions. Pads - The pad thumbnails are now full, filled, glowing waveforms in each slice's colour, with a light-sweep + glow on every trigger and chop-follow step. Layout - One SNAP button (the duplicate up top is gone), and CLEAR now sits evenly in its row. - AI BEAT matches the colour of the other AI buttons. Menus (app menu bar) - View menu mirrors the whole top row — SEQ, MPC, BROWSE, STORE, FX, MIX, ARRANGE, ON AIR — each with a Cmd-1…0 shortcut that actually works. - Analyze BPM / Analyze Key now report the detected tempo / key instead of doing nothing. - About cleaned up. Fixes - Alt-tab / app switching works on the first press again (it used to need two). - Pad recording plays back at the right pitch; QWERTY + MPC pad keys behave; Cmd-A then Delete no longer wipes the loop. - No more duplicate FX plugins in the browser — the installer and the packager both resync the exact 25 plugins every time.
